name: costAndUsage
description: OCI cost or usage from the Usage API, per day or month, grouped and filtered by service, SKU, region, compartment, resource or tag, with an optional forecast

ui.name: groupByTag
ui.label: Group by tag (optional)
ui.help: A tag as `namespace.key`, for example `Oracle-Tags.CreatedBy` or `CostCenter.Project`.

ui.name: includeForecast
ui.label: Add forecast
ui.help: Adds OCI's forecast after the last complete day. Actual cost then ends yesterday (UTC), because OCI only forecasts from complete days. Forecast rows have Forecast = true.
